goal: Generate a 3:4 vertical magazine cover with a news weekly feel, where the main title overlaps with the character but remains readable, and with multiple columns of reading guides at the bottom and sides without blurring edges.

publication.name: TIME Style Sample Magazine (Not Official, For Layout and Style Reference Only)
publication.issue: 2026 Annual Special Issue / December Double Issue

main_visual.description: Sam Altman Bust Portrait, Slight Profile, Expression Calm and Thoughtful, Wearing Deep Blue Suit and White Shirt Without Tie, Soft Indoor Side Light, Clear Face but Not Overly Retouched, Background Gradient from Neutral Gray to Black, No Company Logo
main_visual.composition: The character's face is slightly to the right, with the nose midline around 0.6 of the frame, leaving the bottom left and top right for title and issue number.

title_block.main_title_style: Thick white sans-serif overlay in the area below the character's clothing and left chest, contrasting with skin tone; add 3% dark overlays if necessary

items: Jensen Huang: The three-way chess of computing power and geopolitics
WeChat Ecosystem Ten Years: How Small Apps Grow Big Relationship Chains
Long read: the diverging paths of regulatory sandboxes in California and the EU
Chart: Correlation between Valuation of Large Model Companies and Computing Power Leases
side_teasers.position: Lower left and bottom horizontal bar, fine black or deep red small text, with the main label separated by font size hierarchy

color_palette: Main character warm skin tone + ink black + white text + a narrow red underline or sidebar

barcode.position: Lower right corner, containing a small pricing block and UPC vertical bar, with numbers as a vague indication

must_keep: Character is the absolute emotional focus of the image.
The main title is still recognizable at any thumbnail scale.
Title and issue number do not obscure each other, if a red decorative strip appears, only one, with clear rhythm
avoid: Include the real OpenAI logo in the center of the cover
The main title uses more than three fonts.
Leading text exceeds five lines, crowding the bottom edge
